'''Tustin tournament (The Outer Rim)''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed event in Tustin, California. Eighty-four players started; an 85th joined during game 1. [[Eric Bruen]] won. The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]) and Mystikal ([[Dan Christy]]) published reports on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or-tustin">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport.htm Tustin Tournament Report], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234542/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="or-tustin2">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport2.htm Lower End Of Tustin], The Outer Rim (Mystikal). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234719/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Tustinreport2.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
